text: A fight in total darkness. Who wins?
Almost no one has ever seen it happen. So we look at the evidence.
Sperm whales come up covered in round scars. Sucker marks. Old whales have so many, they overlap.
Squid beaks are hard. They don't digest.
In sixteen sperm whales stranded in New Zealand, researchers counted more than twenty three thousand beaks. Giant squid among them.
A grown sperm whale is more than a hundred times heavier than any giant squid.
The squid leaves scars. The whale leaves with dinner.
But the squid gets the last word. Its remains in whale stomachs helped prove giant squid were real at all.
